_comment: sungwon nominal calibration constants (IDEA_o3, noOpt, Birks ON, neutral filter ON, scaleADC=1, 1 deg tilt + 8 mm vertex smear, field OFF). (raw sum)*constant = GeV. S_crystal/C_crystal: o3_res_eminus_40GeV_p0_noOpt_Digi (3000 ev). S_fiber/C_fiber: o3_calibB_drc_eminus_40GeV_p0_noOpt_scaleADC1_Digi (3000 ev, DRC-only geometry). chi: o3_calibB_piminus_40GeV_p0_noOpt_scaleADC1_Digi (4732 ev), chi_fiber from truth shower_region==3 events, chi_crystal from all events.

chi_crystal_sensitivity._comment: chi_crystal's mean-matching formula divides by E'=E-<E_DR,fiber>, which can be numerically fragile when <S_c> is comparable in magnitude to E' (observed 0.18/0.47/1.85 swings across otherwise-similar analyses). These fields quantify that fragility and give an independent, well-posed estimate.
